Loop Studio: shortcuts

Transport
SpacePlay / stop
EnterGo to beginning
RRecord (plays notes you type into the selected track)
CCycle on/off (drag the yellow bar in the ruler to set the range)
KMetronome
Phone and touch screens
TapSelect; with the Pencil tool tap the piano roll to add a note
Drag in the piano rollMove or resize notes; drag on empty space to select several
Two fingers in the piano rollMove the view; pinch to zoom
Two fingers on the tracksPinch to zoom
Press and hold a region, then dragMove it (a quick swipe scrolls the tracks). Double-tap a region to open it in the piano roll
Press and hold a noteDelete it
Keys tabPlay the selected track with your fingers (keyboard, or pads for drums and the slicer). Slide between keys; − / + changes the octave. Record with R and Record
Arrow button on the editor tabsMake the editor full height and back
Start page → LayoutAuto, Phone (compact) or Desktop
Logic Pro key commands (Windows: Cmd = Ctrl, Option = Alt)
Space / Shift+SpacePlay and stop / play from the start of the selected region
Enter or Home / EndGo to the beginning / the end of the project
, and .Move the playhead one bar back / forward
Up / DownSelect the previous / next track
Ctrl+Left / Ctrl+RightZoom out / in horizontally
USet the cycle range from the selected region
Alt+'Add a marker at the playhead (Alt+Left / Alt+Right jump between markers)
Ctrl+Alt+NNew track (choose the type)
Ctrl+DDuplicate the selected track
Ctrl+BackspaceDelete the selected track (Ctrl+Z brings it back)
Ctrl+JJoin the selected region with the next one
Ctrl+MMute / unmute the selected region
TSplit the selected region at the playhead
Ctrl+S / Ctrl+OSave / open a project
Ctrl+BBounce the project to WAV
Ctrl+I / Ctrl+Alt+IImport an audio file / a MIDI file
Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+ZUndo / redo
Ctrl+KMusical typing (play notes with the computer keyboard)
Alt+KShow these key commands
I, X, P, O, AInspector, Mixer, Piano roll, Loop browser, Automation
Arrange
Double-click laneCreate an empty MIDI region
Drag / edge dragMove / resize a region. Hold Alt while dragging to copy
Ctrl+RRepeat: duplicate the selected region after itself
DeleteDelete region (or note, when the piano roll has focus)
M / SMute / solo the selected track
Double-click regionOpen it in the piano roll
ZZoom the arrange view to fit the whole project
Loop (inspector)Repeat a region's notes: tick Loop, set the loop length, drag the region's right edge
1 – 6Arrange tools: Pointer, Pencil (click or drag on a lane to draw a region), Eraser, Scissors (cut where you click), Glue (join with the next region), Mute. The tool menu is under the track list. Esc returns to the pointer
Inspector › RegionMute, Quantize and Q-Swing, Transpose and Velocity change how a region plays without touching its notes
Inspector › MIDI parametersPer-track transpose, velocity offset, key and velocity limits, delay in ms. “MIDI FX” has an Arpeggiator
OLoop Browser: generated MIDI loops and the audio used in the project. Click to preview, double-click to add at the playhead
Lists / Notes tabsEdit notes and markers as a table; keep project and track notes
MixerGain reduction bars, Bounce in Place per track, Dim on the master, All / Tracks / Single view
Master stripClick it in the mixer to add inserts (Limiter) to the whole mix. File › Export stems saves each track as a WAV
Piano roll
V / BPointer / pencil tool
Double-clickAdd a note (pointer tool). With the pencil a single click adds one
Drag note / right edgeMove / change length. Shift-click adds to selection
Arrow keysTranspose (Shift = octave) and nudge selected notes
Ctrl/Cmd+A, Q, Ctrl/Cmd+DSelect all, quantize, duplicate
WheelScroll pitch. Shift+wheel scrolls time, Ctrl+wheel zooms time, Alt+wheel zooms pitch
Bottom laneDrag over the bars to set velocity
Functions ▾Legato, humanize, reverse, velocity 100, transpose (applies to selected notes, or all)
Files
File → Save projectSaves the whole project (samples included) as a .json file
File → Open project…Opens a project saved before
File → Bounce to WAVRenders the whole mix, with inserts. Inside claude.ai the WAV arrives in a ZIP file
Editing
Ctrl/Cmd+C, X, VCopy, cut and paste regions (at the playhead) or, in the piano roll, notes
TSplit the selected region at the playhead (with Musical Typing off)
Inspector → InsertsAdd Channel EQ, Compressor, Echo or Filter to a track. Click a name to open its settings, double-click a slider to reset it
Sample Slicer
＋ Track → Sample SlicerOr drop an audio file anywhere on the page. Slice 1 is played by C1, slice 2 by C#1 and so on
Click waveformListen to the slice under the cursor
Double-clickAdd a slice marker. Drag a marker to move it, right-click or Alt-click to remove it
WheelZoom the waveform. Shift+wheel scrolls
Create MIDI regionLays the slices out in their original order at the project tempo, so you can rearrange them in the piano roll
Sends and MIDI keyboard
Mixer → ＋ BusAdds a send channel with its own fader and inserts. Tracks feed it with the send sliders (Mixer or Inspector → Sends)
MIDI buttonConnects a MIDI keyboard. Notes play the selected track and are recorded when Record is on. Velocity and the sustain pedal work
Automation, markers and effects
AAutomation view. Choose Volume or Pan, click a lane to add a point, drag points, Alt-click or right-click a point to delete it
Inspector → AutomationOff, Read, Touch (move a fader while playing, it then returns to the curve), Latch (the new value stays), Write (records continuously). The mixer faders follow the curves
Ruler, top rowDouble-click to add a marker, click one to jump, drag to move, double-click it for rename and cycle-to-section, Alt-click to delete. Alt+←/→ jumps between markers
Audio region → In / OutFade in and fade out of an audio region
Inserts → ＋ InsertAlso Reverb, Chorus, Phaser, Tremolo and Distortion
Drummer, audio and mastering
Drum track → DrummerPick a style, complexity, loudness, swing and fills, then ＋ Drummer region. A selected Drummer region rewrites itself when you change a setting. Shuffle makes a new variation. Edit notes in the piano roll afterwards if you like (changing a setting again overwrites them)
File → Import audio file…Adds the file as an Audio Track region at the playhead. Resize, split (T), loop, copy and set the region gain. It plays at its original speed and does not follow tempo changes
Master → Mastering AssistantAnalyzes the mix, then sets EQ, compressor and limiter on the master to reach a loudness target. Undo with Ctrl/Cmd+Z
Step Editor and Pro EQ
Steps tabA grid for the selected region: one row per drum (or per note of a scale), one column per step. Click a step to add or remove it, drag across an empty row to paint, drag an active step up or down for velocity. Click a row name to listen. Steps 1/4 to 1/32, region length, Randomize (Shift-click a row name to limit it to that row), shift left and right, Clear
Mixer insertsEvery strip (tracks, buses and master) has insert slots above the pan knob. Click a slot to open the plugin in its own window, click the dot to bypass, right-click to move or remove, and use the dashed slot to add one
Kick DesignerInstrument for the kick. Punch and Sweep shape the click and pitch drop, Body and Tail set the length, Drive and Clip distort it. The tail is tuned to the note you play, so move the notes for a melodic kick (frenchcore). Pick a style under Preset. Source → Sample pack plays the 18 built-in Zaag kicks (tuned to F, G, E, B or A); other notes pitch the sample, and Length, Drive and Clip still apply.
Hard SynthUnison saws with detune and width, FM, resonant filter with its own envelope, pitch dive, vibrato and heavy distortion. Presets: Screech, Hoover, Euphoric lead, Reverse bass, Raw bass, Uptempo stab, Frenchcore lead, Gabber stab.
Wavetable SynthSerum-style synth (inspired by it, not a copy). Two wavetable oscillators (built-in tables or your own .wav — Serum-format tables work, pick several files at once to fill a Library kept on this device; 📚 in the table list) with a morph Position, Warp (bend, sync, squeeze, mirror, FM, quantize) and up to 16 unison voices. Sub, noise, resonant filter, three envelopes (Env 1 is the amplitude), three LFOs and an 8-slot modulation matrix. Open it with Open synth… in the inspector; drag over a wave picture to move the position. Kick: choose a Kick preset, or use Env 2 → Pitch (all) at +70 to +90 % with a short decay, a sine or Wavefold table as the body, Voices = 1 and the Drive / Clip distortion.
Rumble busIn a track's inspector, under Sends, press Rumble bus from this track (use it on the kick). It creates a bus with a 100% wet reverb, a low-pass, saturation, a high-pass and a compressor keyed by that track, so the rumble swells between kicks. Tune it in the bus inserts: Reverb size sets the length, the low-pass cutoff sets the pitch range. The Rumble Techno template starts with this set up. For a single-plugin version, add the Rumble insert to the kick: the kick stays as it is and the rumble is added next to it, with Amount, Decay, Tune (pitch of the rumble), Low-pass, Drive and a built-in duck keyed by the kick.
Acid SynthAdd a track with the instrument Acid Synth (303): a mono bass line synth with a diode-ladder filter. Knobs: Tuning, Cutoff, Resonance, Env mod, Decay, Accent, Slide time, Distortion, Level. Slide: let a note run past the start of the next one and it glides into it. Accent: notes with velocity above about 108 are louder and open the filter harder. Pick a preset (Acid 303, square, squelch, dirty, overdriven) or press Open synth for the full engine. The Acid Rave template starts with a line like this.
Vocal recordingAdd an Audio Track. In its inspector press Enable microphone (the browser asks once), choose the input, and watch the Level bar move. Then arm the track with R, press Record and Play: everything you sing is captured as raw sound and placed as a region where you started, moved earlier by the sound-card delay. Press Stop to finish the take. If takes sound late or early, change Shift (ms). Monitor lets you hear yourself through the track (only with headphones, otherwise it howls). Record without effects and add Autotune afterwards.
AutotuneAn insert plugin for one voice or one melody line at a time. It listens to the pitch, finds the nearest note of the chosen Key and Scale and pulls the sound there. Retune speed: 0 ms is the hard robotic effect, 40 to 100 ms is a natural correction, slower leaves more of the singing. Amount mixes how far to correct, Flex leaves notes that are already close, Tuning sets the reference pitch. The display shows the sung note, the note it is corrected to and the lit scale keys. It does not work on chords. Corrections of more than about a semitone sound processed.
OTTAn insert plugin: a three-band upward and downward compressor (splits at 88 Hz and 2.5 kHz). It lifts quiet parts and pulls loud parts toward the middle in every band, which gives the dense, bright, "in your face" sound. Depth sets how hard, Time how slow, Upward and Downward set the two halves separately, Low / Mid / High gain shape the bands, Mix blends with the original (parallel). The bars show what each band is doing right now. Loud material is pulled down a lot, so raise Output to compensate. No delay.
Moog LadderAn insert plugin and a filter type in the Wavetable Synth (Moog ladder 24, Acid diode 18). Four saturating one-pole stages with feedback. Modes: LP 24, LP 18, LP 12, BP, HP 24. Env mod opens the cutoff with the input level, the LFO sweeps it. Mix blends with the dry signal.
MIDI filesFile → Import MIDI file… (or drop one or several .mid files on the window; the names BASS, CHORDS, PADS, LEADS pick a matching sound) makes one track per MIDI track or channel, channel 10 becomes a drum track, and the tempo is taken when the project is empty. File → Export MIDI file writes every note track to a .mid (480 ticks per beat). In the claude.ai page the file arrives inside a ZIP.
My synth presetsIn the Wavetable Synth the Save ▾ button stores the current sound as your own preset (shown under “My presets”), overwrites, renames or deletes it, and exports or imports all presets as a .json file. They live in this browser; export them to keep a backup or move them to another computer. Acid Synth tracks have the same under My presets ▾.
Level metersStereo meters with peak hold, a peak number and a clip lamp on every mixer strip, the buses and the master, plus a wide one in the toolbar. Click a meter to reset its peak and clip, right-click to cycle the style. Styles: Tri-colour LED, Classic LED, LCD blue, LCD amber dots and Boombox 90s (the list next to Single in the mixer).
Key HarmonizerAn insert effect for any track (synth, sample, loop), a bus or the master. It moves the partials of the sound onto the notes of the chosen Key and Scale, so a bright lead or a sampled loop stays rich but fits the key. Snap sets how strongly, Low cut leaves the bass and kick untouched, Mix blends with the original. The display shows the sound with the notes of the scale marked (the root in gold). Fast mode adds about 21 ms of delay and High about 43 ms; the other tracks are delayed to match, so everything stays in time (exports are shifted back). It works best on melodic parts; on a whole mix it can raise peaks. Automation: Key, Scale, Snap, Low cut, Mix and Output can be automated on a track (first Key Harmonizer insert). Press A for the automation view, choose “Key Harmonizer · …” in the list next to Auto, and click the lane to add points; Key and Scale step from point to point. Or set the track to Touch / Latch / Write and turn the knobs while the song plays. The knobs follow the curve.
Count-inInspector ▸ Count-in (Off, 1 bar, 2 bars). When Record is on and you press Play, the metronome counts the bars first, then the recording and the song start together
TakesRecord with the loop on and every pass becomes its own take, stacked in the lane. The last take plays; select any take and use Takes here in the Inspector to play only that one or to mute it. Split takes with the scissors to build a comp from the best phrases
Automate OTT and AutotuneAuto button ▸ choose an OTT or Autotune parameter, draw the curve, or set the track to Touch / Latch / Write and move the slider while playing. Works in the bounce too
Loop Synth (native)Desktop app only. Add track ▸ Loop Synth (native). The notes are played by the native audio engine (LoopEngine) straight to the sound card, with the same synth as the Loop Synth VST3: wavetables (also your own Serum .wav files), 3 LFOs and a modulation matrix. The fader, pan, mute and solo work. Inserts, sends, automation and export do not reach these tracks yet. If they sound early or late against other tracks, change Engine ▸ Sync offset.
Sound healthAppearance ▸ Sound and performance ▸ Sound health… counts dropouts, page freezes and stuck notes and gives a report you can copy. A note that is held for more than 25 seconds with no key down is released automatically; there is also a limit on how many voices sound at once
Hanging notes and crackleEsc releases every note you are holding. Press Stop again while stopped to cut everything that still sounds (“panic”). Notes from the computer keyboard also work with a Ukrainian or Russian layout. If the sound crackles, open Appearance ▸ Sound and performance and set Audio buffer to Safe (reload the page after), and turn on Light visuals. The app warns you when it notices the sound breaking up.
Rainbow soundsWavetable Synth presets “Rainbow lead (glide)”, “Rainbow dive” and “Rainbow rise”: a fast pitch envelope on a thick saw stack makes the harmonics fan out (dive falls, rise climbs, the lead slides between overlapping notes). Put a Key Harmonizer after them to tune the sweep into the key. The “Rainbow Drop” template shows it all at 200 BPM.
Synth FX tabThe Wavetable Synth has an FX tab with eight slots that run in order after the voice: Distortion, Chorus, Flanger, Phaser, Delay (ms or tempo-synced, ping-pong), Reverb, EQ, Filter and Compressor. Click a slot to edit it, use the power button to bypass it and ◀ ▶ to change the order. Each effect has its own LFO (sine, triangle, saw, square, free or tempo-synced) that can move one of its parameters. Effects are saved with the preset.
Audio trim & stretchDrag the left or right edge of an audio region to trim it (the sound stays in place). In the Region inspector: Stretch — Off, Follow tempo (fits the sample to the project BPM, pitch unchanged) or Speed (tempo and pitch change together). Set Sample BPM by hand, with Detect, or with ×2 / ÷2, or enter a loop length in bars. Pitch shifts ±24 semitones independently of tempo. Fit region to sample sets the region to the sample length. Stretching is rendered in the background and cached; it sounds best within about ±30%.
Harmonic DistortionInsert effect that distorts only the part of the spectrum you choose and leaves the rest untouched, so nothing is cut away: a Band (a bump around a frequency), everything below or everything above a frequency. Drag in the top picture to set frequency and width; Listen plays only the distorted band. Eight characters (Soft, Tube, Hard clip, Fold, Diode, Fuzz, Rectify, Bit), harmonic knobs H2…H9 that add chosen harmonics on top, 4× oversampling, Tone, Mix and Output. An LFO (free or tempo-synced) and an envelope follower can move Drive, Frequency, Bias and Mix.
Drum Kit → Hard danceA harder drum set: snappy snare, layered clap with a long tail, short metallic hats and a long crash. Switch it in the inspector under Drum Kit. The hard dance templates use it.
Start page → InterfaceHard dance (minimal) hides Slicer, Lists, Notes, Loops and Auto so the window shows only the piano roll, mixer and step editor. Switch back to Full at any time.
FX Riser / ImpactRisers, downlifters and noise sweeps last as long as the note you draw. Impact is a boom with a noise thud.
Inserts → Clipper, BitcrusherClipper pushes the signal into a soft or hard ceiling with 4× oversampling. Put it on the master before the Limiter. Bitcrusher reduces the bit depth.
Master → GlueSwitches the gentle glue compressor on the master bus on or off. The hard dance templates start with it off.
Inserts → CompressorPro-C style. The display scrolls the input level (grey) and the gain reduction (orange, hanging from the top). Drag the dashed threshold line or the knee edges. Knobs: Threshold, Ratio (up to ∞), Knee, Range, Attack, Release, Hold, side-chain low cut, Gain and Mix. Eight styles (Clean, Classic, Opto, Vocal, Mastering, Bus, Punch, Pumping), Auto gain and presets. The curve on the right shows the real compression with a live dot. Sidechain: pick another track or bus (for example the kick ducking the bass); the grey line in the display then shows that track's level, and Listen plays the signal the compressor reacts to. There is no look-ahead, so it adds no delay.
Inserts → Pro EQClick the curve or the name to open the editor. Double-click the graph to add a band (up to 8). Drag a node for frequency and gain, scroll over it for Q (for cuts: 12, 24 or 48 dB per octave). Right-click a node for the type: bell, shelves, cuts, notch. The grey area is the spectrum, after or before the EQ
Start page, themes and controls
File → Start page / new project…Continue, a clean project, a template (Beat Maker, Songwriter, Electronic, Lo-fi, Audio Mixing, Sample Slicing), the demo or the previous project. The right column sets tempo, metronome, snap, panels, track height and theme for new projects. Untick "Show this page at startup" to skip it
File → Appearance and themes…Ten built-in themes. Change any colour and a copy is saved as your own theme. Quick theme builds a full set from a tint and an accent. Also track colours, corner radius, font, text size, track height and flat buttons. Export and Import share a theme as a .json file
Faders and knobsDrag up or down. Hold Shift for fine control, use the mouse wheel or the arrow keys, double-click to reset (faders to 0 dB, pan to centre)
Musical Typing
A W S E D F T G Y H U J KC to C, on the selected track. Z / X changes the octave
